governance.note: Continuation of the pjm-51 SE-inelastic seam base (pjm-48 coal keeper + pjm-49 MISO/NYISO realized-LMP heat-rate anchors + pjm-50 firm-export floor / losses hurdle / TVA-LGEE seams + pjm-51 Southeast gas-INELASTIC affine reference price), all previously attested. NEW this run: the ISO-agnostic MISO coal-bituminous 3-lever stack. Lever 1 (coal_mustrun_online_pmin + coal_sync_srmc_tranche): the coal must-run band is sized to the MEASURED online-net-MW synchronization Pmin from the CAMPD per-plant artifact (data/raw/_processed-legacy/thermal_tranches_PJM.csv mustrun_online_pct, ~31% nameplate mean across 29 PJM coal plants vs the ~16% all-hours mustrun_pct), split into a fuel-free contracted floor + a full-SRMC synchronization band, both forced on (erosion fix holds the coal_sync_pmin_mw tranches at availability=1.0 so the statistical WEFOR derate cannot pull the floor below its measured cap; real CAMPD outage windows + unit derates still relax it). A physical availability/synchronization measurement, forward-reproducible from forward fleet data (rule #12). Lever 2: coal min-run/min-down 36/16 (NREL baseload class), a documented physical commitment constraint applied via the P2 coal screen, not residual-tuned. Lever 3 (coal_bit_sigmoid, floor 0.76->0.68): gas-keyed bituminous BID sigmoid that discounts the OFFER (take-or-pay / stay-running competitive bidding under cheap gas), NOT the delivered coal price; keyed off the monthly delivered gas price so it self-targets the cheap-gas merit-order crossover and is forward-reproducible; dear-gas ceiling 1.32 left at the table default. No residual-tuned adders, no load proxy, no haircut, no output pinning to actuals. pjm-48 remains the PJM keeper; this is a structural diagnostic on the COAL_BIT under-run (rule #1).
